## About
Texas Landscaping & Fence does landscaping, hardscaping and fences for homes in the Houston area, working out of Garden Meadow Dr in Katy.
Samir and his crew do the work. Reviewers have mentioned front and backyard landscaping, backyard fence replacements, a shared fence redone across neighbors' properties, and drains put in around a house to protect the foundation.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 85 reviews.

## Services
- Landscaping: Front and backyard landscaping. One reviewer called the work affordable and said it was done quickly with no problems afterward.
- Replacement of shared fences: Fences shared with neighbors replaced using quality materials, including rot boards all around.
- Drains around the house: Drains put in around the house to help save the foundation from sinking.

## FAQ
Q: Can you replace a fence we share with our neighbors?
A: Yes. On one job Samir worked with all the owners and split the cost between them on each segment of the fence.

Q: Can you help with water problems around my foundation?
A: We put in drains around the house. One customer said he no longer worries when it rains.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday.
